card.name: Start of a name before its rest
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a proper name (a surname, place or language name) in web text, right before the rest of the name is spelled out. Often a lone capital such as K, H or G.

modes.label: Surname start
modes.description: The first letter or piece of a person's surname after a first name or 'and'.

modes.label: Place or language name start
modes.description: The first piece of a place, hyphenated title or language name.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word 'assembly' and its forms, which looks like a side effect with little link to these names.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letter of a name that is about to be completed, mostly surnames and place names.
